action.objective: Convert the material advantage safely: consolidate with c2c3 and keep the extra piece, avoiding queen tactics.
action.rationale: c2c3 is the only commit_ready move: verified at depth 4 (exact 1260), mate-in-one safety complete, tactical_refutation not_found. It defends the d4 pawn push (dxc3 recaptured) and keeps our extra material from the earlier Bxd8 gain. Note Qxc3+ is possible but after the queen trade/retreat our rook surplus stands. f1g2 is shallower (depth 2, 1366) and not comparable. No replan required.
